window.EventCalendar=function(el){if(el=$(el),el.length!=0){var service=el.data("service"),target=$(el.data("target")),initialDate=FW.parseDate(el.data("first_event")),dayCache={},monthCache={},checkDay=function(date){return dayCache[date]==null?[!1]:dayCache[date]!=null?[!0,dayCache[date],dayCache[date]]:void 0},changeDay=function(date){FW.Lazy.Fetch(service+"&cmd=event_list&date="+date+"&query="+encodeURIComponent(location.search),target);addAccessibility()},changeMonth=function(year,month){var dtstart=new Date(year,month-1,1),dtend=new Date(year,month+1,1);monthCache[dtstart]==null?monthCache[dtstart]=$.ajax({url:service+"&cmd=event_dates&dtstart="+$.datepicker.formatDate("yy-mm-dd",dtstart)+"&dtend="+$.datepicker.formatDate("yy-mm-dd",dtend),dataType:"json",success:changeMonthCallback}):addAccessibility()},changeMonthCallback=function(data){for(var date,dates=data.dates,i=0;i<dates.length;i++)date=$.datepicker.parseDate("yy-mm-dd",dates[i][0]),dayCache[date]==null&&(dayCache[date]=dates[i][1]=="0"?"available":"unavailable");el.datepicker("refresh");addAccessibility()},addAccessibility=function(){window.setTimeout(function(){el.find("a:not([href])").attr("href","#").on("click",function(){return!1})},0)};el.datepicker({minDate:initialDate,maxDate:"1Y",firstDay:FW.Config.firstDay==null?1:FW.Config.firstDay,beforeShowDay:checkDay,onChangeMonthYear:changeMonth,onSelect:changeDay});changeMonth(initialDate.getFullYear(),initialDate.getMonth()+1)}};window.EventMap=function(el){var focus,centerArr,map;if(el.length!=0&&typeof jvm!="undefined"){var service=el.data("service"),replace=el.data("replace")=="1",target=$(el.data("target")),zoom=el.data("scale"),center=el.data("center"),selected_map=el.data("selected_map"),lastDrag,init={container:el,map:selected_map,backgroundColor:"rgb(171, 216, 255, 0.6)",zoomOnScroll:!0,panOnDrag:!0,zoomButtons:!0,zoomMin:1,zoomMax:8,regionStyle:{initial:{fill:"#f5f5f5",stroke:"black","stroke-width":"0.3px"},hover:{cursor:"inherit","fill-opacity":1}},markerStyle:{initial:{fill:el.data("marker_color"),stroke:"transparent","stroke-width":"0",r:5},hover:{cursor:"inherit",fill:el.data("marker_color"),"stroke-width":"0",stroke:"transparent"}}};(center||zoom)&&(focus={},zoom&&(focus.scale=zoom),center&&(centerArr=center.split(","),focus.lat=centerArr[0],focus.lng=centerArr[1]),init.focusOn=focus);init.onViewportChange=function(e,scale){lastDrag=Date.now();zoom=scale};map=new jvm.Map(init);$.get(service+"&cmd=event_markers&query="+encodeURIComponent(location.search),function(data){map.addMarkers(data)});el.on("click",function(e){if(!$(e.target).is(" div.jvectormap-zoomin, div.jvectormap-zoomout")&&!(Date.now()-lastDrag<1e3)){lastMouseDown=null;var online=$(":checkbox[data-map='"+el.prop("id")+"']").is(":checked"),latLng=map.pointToLatLng(e.offsetX,e.offsetY);latLng!=null&&latLng.lat!=null&&FW.Lazy.Fetch(service+(online?"&online=1":"")+"&cmd=event_list&l="+latLng.lat+","+latLng.lng+"&query="+encodeURIComponent(location.search),target,function(){replace&&el.remove()})}});el.on("dblclick",function(){zoom||(zoom=1);zoom+=1.6;var pX=el.width()/2,pY=el.height()/2,latLng=map.pointToLatLng(pX,pY);map.setFocus({scale:zoom,lat:latLng.lat,lng:latLng.lng})});$("button.map_search_button[data-map='"+el.prop("id")+"']").on("click",function(){var searchDiv=$(this).closest("div.map_search"),zip=searchDiv.find("input.zip").val(),country=searchDiv.find("select.country").val(),online=$(":checkbox.include_online[data-map='"+el.prop("id")+"']").is(":checked"),url=service+"&cmd=event_list&query="+encodeURIComponent(location.search),error;url+=zip?"&zip="+zip:"&country="+country;online&&(url+="&online=1");error=!1;FW.Lazy.Fetch(url,target,{callback:function(){replace&&!error&&el.remove()},error:function(){error=!0;zip?alert("Zip not found."):alert("There was a problem completing the search.")}})});$("button.map_browse_button[data-map='"+el.prop("id")+"']").on("click",function(){var searchDiv=$(this).closest("div.map_search"),online=$(":checkbox.include_online[data-map='"+el.prop("id")+"']").is(":checked"),url=service+"&cmd=event_list&group_by=country&query="+encodeURIComponent(location.search),error;online&&(url+="&online=1");error=!1;FW.Lazy.Fetch(url,target,{callback:function(){replace&&!error&&el.remove()},error:function(){error=!0;alert("There was a problem completing the search.")}})})}};
